title: PUID: A Personalized Deconfounding Framework for Recommender Systems under Hidden Confounding
abstract: arXiv:2605.21066v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recommender systems often rely on observational user-item interaction data, which is prone to selection bias due to users' selective interactions with items. While techniques such as inverse propensity weighting (IPW) and doubly robust estimators are effective in addressing selection bias from observed confounding, they become unreliable when hidden confounding exists, meaning that there are confounders that influence both user clicks and feedback but are not observable (e.g., user salary). Existing approaches relying on randomized controlled trials (RCTs) or global sensitivity bounds are constrained in practice: RCTs demand costly experimental data, while global sensitivity bounds presume a uniformly bounded effect of unmeasured confounders on propensities through sensitivity analysis, thereby neglecting heterogeneity across user-item interactions. To overcome this limitation, we propose a novel framework, Personalized Unobserved-Co

translated_title: PUID：一种面向隐藏混杂下推荐系统的个性化去混杂框架
translated_abstract: 推荐系统通常依赖于观察性的用户-物品交互数据，这类数据由于用户对物品的选择性交互而容易产生选择偏差。尽管逆倾向加权（IPW）和双重稳健估计器等技术能有效应对来自可观察混杂因素的选择偏差，但当存在隐藏混杂时（即存在同时影响用户点击和反馈却不可观察的混杂因素，例如用户薪资），这些方法便变得不可靠。现有依赖随机对照试验（RCT）或全局敏感性界限的方法在实践中存在局限：RCT需要代价高昂的实验数据，而全局敏感性界限则通过敏感性分析假设未测量混杂因素对倾向的影响被统一约束在固定范围内，从而忽略了用户-物品交互之间的异质性。为克服这一局限，我们提出了一个新颖的框架——个性化未观察混杂因子去混杂框架（PUID）……
tldr: 论文提出PUID个性化去混杂框架，以个性化的敏感性界限取代全局统一界限来处理推荐系统中的隐藏混杂因素，克服了传统方法忽略用户-物品交互异质性的缺陷。
